name: Super Mario Bros.

rom.title: Super Mario Bros. (World) (No-Intro, NES 2.0 header)
rom.tasvideos_version: https://tasvideos.org/Games/1/Versions/View/68 (Super Mario Bros. (W) [!], GoodNES 3.23: the same game data, an iNES 1.0 header)
rom.note: Your own dump or copy; never in this repository. BizHawk reports the SHA-1 of the whole file (header included), which is `sha1`.

memory.source: periwinkle9/smb-autosplitter (Zlib), SuperMarioBros.asl: worldNum 0x75F, levelNum 0x75C, operMode 0x770; its end of the run is worldNum >= 7 and operMode becoming 2 (the axe in 8-4). Measured in BizHawk 2.11.1 on 2026-09-23: title operMode 0; after Start operMode 1, world 0, level 0; the TAS reaches 2-1 at frame 8400 and 3-1 at frame 17400.

goal: Beat the game: defeat Bowser at the end of World 8-4. Each world counts as a split.
controls: D-pad Left/Right to walk, Down to duck (as Super Mario), B to run and to throw fireballs, A to jump (hold longer to jump higher), Start to begin at the title screen and to pause.

tas.title: NES Super Mario Bros. "warpless" by HappyLee & Mars608 in 18:36.78
tas.license: CC BY 2.0 (TASVideos): tool-assisted, by HappyLee & Mars608
tas.sync: Imported into BizHawk 2.11.1 (NesHawk), the movie falls out of sync in 3-1 when BizHawk plays it itself, without any tool: from frame 17460 to 20040 Mario stands at x 496-506 (measured 2026-09-23 19:46-19:53; the movie was made in FCEUX 2.2.1). Through bizhawk-mcp-native v0.3.2 it follows the movie through World 2 and stops at the same place in 3-1. The mock stops after World 2.
tas.core: NesHawk (BizHawk's importer puts it in the movie's header; the mock refuses another core)

bot.about: The mock replays the TAS's own input, frame by frame, through the same buttons the agent has, from power-on; its goal is World 2, the part of the movie BizHawk plays in sync.
